title: Model staging directory + sync-models tool
description:
Create a single directory the mesh viewer reads from, populated by a new 'uv run sync-models' CLI from multiple source locations. Keeps the viewer decoupled from where the authoritative files live (resources, KriegEterna web static, ~/Blends), and gives a clean swap point when the future S3-backed resources ticket lands.

Target: ~/.ix/ixdar-models/ (override via IXDAR_MODEL_DIR env var)
Subfolders: dsl/, obj/voyage/, obj/blends/

Behaviour:
1. Resolve target dir.
2. Ensure subfolders exist.
3. Walk sources:
   - Ixdar/ixdar-app/src/main/resources/dsl/*.dsl → symlink into dsl/
   - KriegEterna/web/static/ixdar/obj/*.obj → symlink into obj/voyage/
   - ~/Blends/**/*.obj recursively → symlink into obj/blends/<subdir>/... preserving structure
4. Clean stale symlinks (pointing to deleted files) before re-linking.
5. Print summary: N DSL, M voyage OBJ, K Blends OBJ.

Symlinks not copies — no OBJ duplication, source edits reflect immediately. Idempotent: a no-op re-run completes fast and changes nothing.

New file: Daud/src/daud/tools/sync_models.py
Entry point: sync-models in Daud/pyproject.toml [project.scripts].

Future S3 ticket replaces the source resolution with S3 downloads; the viewer's ModelCatalog (VIEW-7) stays identical.
definition-of-done: uv run sync-models in an empty ~/.ix state creates the target, populates symlinks from all three sources, prints a summary. Running again is idempotent. Deleting a source DSL and re-running cleans the stale symlink.
testing-plan: (1) rm -rf ~/.ix/ixdar-models (if exists). (2) uv run sync-models. (3) Verify target structure. (4) Re-run — no errors, same counts. (5) Delete one symlink manually, re-run — it reappears. (6) Delete a source file, re-run — stale symlink removed.
